boundary: Exact noiseless injectivity and finite normalized-conditioning audit. ADC transfer functions, coefficient calibration, correlated sensor noise and globally optimal robust row design remain open.
pareto_note: The exact two-channel information-theoretic minimum is preserved. The selected signed-16 pair maximizes the stated normalized worst-case score among the 91 exact-passing candidates in this frozen 600-pair search; global optimality over all integer row pairs is not claimed.

search.generation: for each candidate draw two length-160 integer arrays uniformly from [0,p), center modulo p into [-32768,32768], reject unless every short-cycle response pair and every theta determinant is nonzero modulo p
